description: Mining: Watch the Seam: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: The crew is working a seam in {system} and {enemy} ships keep turning up. Guard them until the shift is done.
Mining watch. Two miners, three hours of work. Well, three minutes of yours.
{client} needs the crew kept safe while they dig. Stay close.
success: The shift ends and the hold is full. {client} pays {captain}.
Crew safe. Ore loaded. {client} sends thanks.
Good watch. The miners say so too.
failure: A miner is lost. {client} ends the shift.
The crew is lost. {client} will not forget it.
radio-crew: Crew at the seam. Keep watch.
They have the cutters out. Your job begins.
radio-pirates: Pirates, far side. Two of them.
Contact. Two. They want the ore.
radio-pirates2: Second group. They did not learn.
